title: Successful Pairs of Spells and Potions

solutions.better:
class Solution:
    def successfulPairs(self, spells: list[int], potions: list[int], success: int) -> list[int]:
        import bisect
        potions.sort()
        m = len(potions)
        ans = []
        for s in spells:
            need = (success + s - 1) // s
            pos = bisect.bisect_left(potions, need)
            ans.append(m - pos)
        return ans
